title: Bocce Roll
tagline: Pull back, roll, curve, bank it off the rails.
description: Italian bocce on a lit garden court. Slingshot your ball toward the pallino, choose to roll, lob or hit, add curve, bank off the rails and outplay six rivals, a partner team, or a friend.
howToPlay: Press on the lower court and drag back like a slingshot, then let go to throw.
Pull length sets the power and pull direction sets the aim.
Choose Roll, Lob or Hit and add curve with the arrows.
The side whose ball is not closest keeps playing; the closest ball scores.
